description:
𝗩𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀 — you got a "𝘆𝗲𝘀" on your VA loan… and still didn't close. 🛑

How? Your lender never asked about your 𝗘𝗧𝗦 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲.

Getting out in the next 12 months and not re-enlisting? They 𝗰𝗮𝗻'𝘁 use that income to qualify you.

The questions a lazy lender skips 👇
▪️ 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁'𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗘𝗧𝗦 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲?
▪️ 𝗖𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗼𝗿 𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘆?
▪️ 𝗗𝗮𝘆𝗰𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘁𝘀? (it counts against you on a VA loan)

Ask these 𝗗𝗔𝗬 𝗢𝗡𝗘 — not 15 days before closing. 💯
